source: Genuine disposable Windows Sandbox region overlays over its public/default guest desktop. No PNG fixture is loaded; an unused common-wrapper fixture field in raw reports is not source-content provenance.

cursor: The GDI observer draws the actual guest cursor. Additional rings, if any, must be labelled Recorded input position.
limitation: Whole-display observer load differs, observed17.7–22.7fps. One gesture per app/tool, application defaults. No input-to-visible or speed ranking from these clips. ShareX Space did not produce a PNG in the task save directory, so only its visible drawing is verified.
